flags.title: Every build run uses the full hour: no run rations usage on its own
flags.why: Matt, 2026-11-07, in the ev-build channel: "use the full hour". Runs had stopped after one or two small tasks to save usage against a daily cap nobody had confirmed. AGENTS.md §9 now says a run ends early only when the platform stops it or nothing is left that doesn't wait on Matt.
